profile.title: Profile
profile.noFamily: You are not in a family yet.
profile.createFamilyHint: Or use an invite link to join an existing family.
profile.codeHint: Share the code with someone who wants to join. One-time code, expires after 1 hour.
profile.linkHint: Share the link with someone who wants to join. Link expires after 1 hour.
profile.reloadHelp: Loading latest version of the app.
profile.spondHelp: Connect to Spond to show team events.
profile.helpCalendarWhatText: Connect Google Calendar or Outlook to sync your family's events. Events from the app appear in your personal calendar.
profile.helpCalendarHowText: Tap 'Connect calendar' and sign in with Google or Outlook. Choose which calendar to use. Events sync automatically.
profile.helpCalendarTip: You can disconnect at any time. Events remain in the app.
profile.helpNotificationsWhatText: Get reminders before events start. You can turn notifications on or off.
profile.helpNotificationsHowText: Select 'On' to receive reminders, or 'Off' to disable them. Reminders are sent based on the reminder set in each event.
profile.helpMinUkeWhatText: Choose which sections are shown in the 'This Week' tab in Food Center. Hide sections you don't need to see.
profile.helpMinUkeHowText: Toggle the switches for each section. Changes take effect immediately.
profile.helpMinUkeTip: You can change these settings anytime.
profile.helpMatsenterWhatText: Choose which meal sections are shown in the weekly meal planner. Customize based on your family's needs.
profile.helpMatsenterHowText: Toggle breakfast, lunch and dinner on or off. Only active meals appear in the weekly plan.
profile.helpMatsenterTip: You can change this anytime in Profile settings.
profile.helpBirthdaysWhatText: Manage family birthdays and get reminders. Birthdays appear on the events page.
profile.helpBirthdaysHowText: Tap 'Add birthday' to add a new one. Enter the name and select a date. The birthday is added as an annual event.
profile.helpBirthdaysTip: You can add up to 50 birthdays.
profile.helpFamilyWhatText: Manage family members, roles and invitations. Only owners and admins can invite and remove members.
profile.helpFamilyHowText: Tap 'Generate code' to create an invitation code. Share the code with the person joining. Owners and admins can also remove members.
profile.helpFamilyTip: Invitation codes expire after 1 hour and can only be used once.
profile.helpSpondWhatText: Connect to Spond to show your team's events and activities directly in the app. See who's attending and respondents.
profile.helpSpondHowText: Enter your Spond email and password, tap 'Connect'. Choose which groups to show. Spond events appear automatically on the events page.
profile.helpSpondTip: Your Spond password is stored securely. You can disconnect at any time.

detail.helpTransportWhatText: Add flights, trains, ferries, car rentals and taxis for your trip. See an overview of all transport legs.
detail.helpTransportHowText: Tap the '+' button and choose transport type. Fill in details like date, time, route and prices.
detail.helpTransportTip: You can add multiple transport legs and edit them later.
detail.helpHotelsWhatText: Manage accommodations for your trip. Add hotels with check-in, check-out and reference numbers.
detail.helpHotelsHowText: Tap the '+' button and enter the hotel name, dates and contact details.
detail.helpHotelsTip: You can add multiple hotels for different parts of the trip.
detail.helpRestaurantsWhatText: Plan dining for your trip. Add restaurants with date, time and reservation info.
detail.helpRestaurantsHowText: Tap the '+' button and enter the restaurant name, address and any reservation details.
detail.helpRestaurantsTip: You can mark restaurants as visited afterwards.
detail.helpActivitiesWhatText: Plan activities and experiences for your trip. Add attractions, tours and events.
detail.helpActivitiesHowText: Tap the '+' button and enter the activity name, date, time and location.
detail.helpActivitiesTip: You can add notes and photos to each activity.
detail.helpTipsWhatText: Get AI-generated tips for your destination. Restaurants, attractions and activities sorted by category.
detail.helpTipsHowText: Enter the city name in the search field and tap 'Get tips'. Tips are automatically sorted by category.
detail.helpDocumentsWhatText: Upload and store important travel documents like flight tickets, passport copies and hotel reservations.
detail.helpDocumentsHowText: Tap the '+' button to upload a file. Give the document a name so you can find it later.
detail.helpDocumentsTip: Documents are stored securely in the cloud and available offline.

mealPlanner.title: Food Center
mealPlanner.importURL: Paste URL from matprat.no or similar
mealPlanner.helpWhatText: The weekly plan lets you plan meals for the whole week. You can add breakfast, lunch and dinner for each day.
mealPlanner.helpHowText: Tap a day to choose a recipe from the book. You can also use 'Random dish' to get a suggestion.
mealPlanner.helpTip: You can change the meal later by tapping it again.
mealPlanner.helpSettingsText: In the profile under Food center you can choose which meal types to show: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner.
mealPlanner.helpRandomTitle: What should we have for dinner today
mealPlanner.helpRandomWhatText: Not inspired for today's dinner? Press the button and we'll suggest a dish from your recipe book.
mealPlanner.helpRandomHowText: Press «Random dish» to get a suggestion. The dish is added directly as dinner in today's plan. You can also press to view the recipe.
mealPlanner.helpRandomTip: Press several times to get new suggestions.
mealPlanner.helpRandomSettingsText: Suggestions come from your recipe book under Food center.
mealPlanner.helpSearchWhatText: Search for recipes in your book. You can search by dish names.
mealPlanner.helpSearchHowText: Type a search term in the search field. If you can't find what you're looking for, you can use AI search to generate a new recipe based on a description.
mealPlanner.helpSearchTip: You can also import recipes from websites by pasting a URL.
mealPlanner.helpSearchSettingsText: All recipes are saved in Food center under the Recipes tab.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchWhatText: AI Search uses artificial intelligence to generate recipes based on what you type. If you can't find a recipe in your book, AI can help you create a new one based on your description.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchHowText: Type a search word in the search field. If no results appear, click the 'Search with AI' button. Select which country you want to search recipes from – you can search for country names in the dropdown. AI search generates three suggestions with ingredients and instructions.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchTip: You can edit the recipe after it has been generated to match your preferences.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteWhatText: Shopping lists let you collect items you need to buy. You can create your own lists or get ingredients from recipes.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteHowText: Press '+' to create a new shopping list. Enter the list name and press Save.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteRecipeText: When you open a recipe and press 'Add to shopping list', all ingredients are automatically added to the shopping list.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteRecipeTip: Ingredients are translated to the language you selected in your profile.
mealPlanner.whatToEat: What should we have for dinner today?
mealPlanner.urlImportHint: Paste link from a recipe page
